dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Pronounced symmetrical narrowing of the 2D body envelope beginning posterior to the mid-section and extending toward the peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Subtle, symmetrical expansion in the nuchal region immediately posterior to the head, followed by smooth lateral margins.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high median pixel intensity across the entire visible dorsal surface with minimal grayscale variance.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A series of approximately 3-5 small, high-contrast dark spots are visible along the left lateral margin.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Prominent linear mid-axial ridge extending from the mid-back posteriorly, casting a slight shadow indicating elevation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized dark point marks on the left lateral margin; minor structural indentation visible immediately posterior to the blowhole.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, circular, high-contrast dark blowhole aperture on the anterior dorsal surface.
